13:40.race_name: Bet Smarter With Oddschecker Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Maiden winner; off since November but brings potential into handicaps
runners.name: So You Know
runners.spotlight: First run after wind surgery and in a tongue-tie when leading late on in a Huntingdon maiden (2m, good) and probably even better when second under a penalty next time; off since November but brings potential into handicaps.

runners.comment: Only 2lb higher than for his narrow Hereford win and a likely contender
runners.name: Ukantango
runners.spotlight: Back from a break to register a third win over hurdles when on top late on at Hereford in January (2m, soft); only went up 2lb.

runners.comment: A winner in Ireland; there were reasons for his weak finish on stable debut; back in trip
runners.name: Newtown Rambler
runners.spotlight: Maiden winner in Ireland and later placed in handicaps over fences; strong in the betting on last month's stable debut (2m4f; back hurdling) and weakened after getting taken on a good way out; new headgear combination tried and he's of interest.

runners.comment: Smart Flat horse and this is her first handicap over hurdles away from the mud
runners.name: Mo Ghille Mar
runners.spotlight: Three Flat wins for Jessica Harrington at a smart level; plenty to prove over hurdles but her defeats in handicaps were on slow ground that wasn't ideal; possibilities.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras DEnki
runners.comment: Has shown enough to believe he can be more competitive at this level on handicap debut
runners.name: Tao Enki
runners.spotlight: No closer than 13l in three runs over hurdles but has shown enough to believe he can be a lot more competitive at this level.

runners.comment: Hasn't been on his game in either discipline on last four starts; bit to prove
runners.name: Gifted Angel
runners.spotlight: Has won on the AW and over hurdles, with five victories combined; however, hasn't been on his game in either discipline on last four starts; bit to prove.

runners.comment: Late rain was no help last time at Taunton; interesting with a tongue-tie back on
runners.name: Time Interval
runners.spotlight: Made all on consecutive outings last spring, latterly over C&D on good ground; has struggled in his last four races but, while the official description was good last time at Taunton, it rained that day and conditions looked tiring; the return of a tongue-tie is another positive; interesting.

runners.comment: Pulled up on handicap debut; could benefit from a drier surface and the added tongue-tie
runners.name: Northanger Abbey
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced but was a 25-1 market drifter when pulled up on his handicap debut (2m4f, soft); could benefit from this drier surface and the addition of a tongue-tie.

runners.comment: Good mark and drying ground will help, but his form has come over further
runners.name: Supreme Yeats
runners.owner: The Old Stag Racing Sy Partnership
runners.spotlight: Testing ground hasn't been ideal in his last two races and he defied a similar mark on good ground last summer, albeit over nearly 3m; this distance is a worry.

runners.comment: Still early days and he's unexposed on this sort of ground; hard to dismiss
runners.name: Choice Runner
runners.spotlight: Hasn't progressed in handicaps (2m4f/2m) but still early days and he's unexposed on this sort of ground; hard to dismiss.

runners.comment: 9l fourth in a novice two runs back suggests he has the ability to feature off this mark
runners.name: Get In Order
runners.spotlight: His 9l fourth in a Hereford novice two runs back suggests he has the ability to feature off this sort of mark in handicaps; market confidence would be welcomed after three months away.

runners.comment: Showed a bit more when beaten about 12l in a Chepstow maiden two weeks ago
runners.name: Stone Cold
runners.spotlight: Showed a bit more when beaten about 12l in a Chepstow maiden two weeks ago and a tongue-tie is added for this handicap debut; could take another step forward.

runners.comment: The hood is working well; his improvement has come over further and others appeal more
runners.name: A Good Yomp
runners.spotlight: The hood seems to be working well but his improvement has come over further and others appeal more; regularly ridden by 10lb claimer Dillon Butler.

14:10.race_name: Oddschecker Free Bets Novices' Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB) (Div I)

runners.comment: Struggled in warm handicap last time but has major claims back down in class
runners.name: Great Fleet
runners.spotlight: Solid on his form with Conman John over longer trips in October and opened his hurdles account in Kelso contest (2m, soft) in December; struggled in warm handicap since but holds major claims back down in class.

runners.comment: Superbly bred; likely to build on his Southwell success and show further progress
runners.name: Wilstar
runners.spotlight: Superbly bred, being a half-brother to Douvan and Jonbon; not in their league but doubled his career tally with Southwell maiden success (2m, good to soft) most recently and looks likely to progress further; respected.

runners.comment: Made the frame twice in Irish bumpers; lesser effort over hurdles for new yard
runners.name: Answer That
runners.spotlight: Made the frame twice in Irish bumpers; seemed to need the run in Plumpton maiden hurdle (2m) for new yard but needs to improve sharply on that bare form and may be one for handicaps later on.

runners.breeder: Tommy James Eoin Banville & Lucy Norton
runners.comment: Has very weak claims on rules form
runners.name: Bargain Hunter
runners.spotlight: Placed in one of his Irish points but has very weak claims on rules form; second attempt over hurdles.

runners.comment: Bumper winner at Warwick; consistent elsewhere since switched to hurdles; solid
runners.name: Legal Weapon
runners.spotlight: Gained his bumper success at Warwick; consistent elsewhere since switched to hurdles, making the frame each time; ran particularly well at Newbury (2m, good to soft) on penultimate start; solid chance back here.

runners.comment: Poor claims on form
runners.name: Scrumpyjack
runners.spotlight: Duck egg in bumper and pulled up in 2m3f maiden hurdle; poor claims.

runners.comment: Has shown ability but he needs improvement to get off the mark
runners.name: Typhoon Warrior
runners.spotlight: Never figured in heavy-ground event won by a smart sort last time; consistent efforts in two bumpers and a novice hurdle otherwise but needs improvement to get off the mark; stable second string.

runners.comment: Showed promise at Ludlow in December and looks open to progress
runners.name: Ample Warning
runners.spotlight: Missed last season but showed promise switched to hurdles at Ludlow (2m) in December, making the frame, and this twice-raced mare looks open to progress.

runners.comment: Point/bumper winner who has regressed in two hurdles attempts
runners.name: Ballylicky Bay
runners.spotlight: Point/bumper winner who has regressed in two starts since switched to hurdles; not exactly solid, with a major turnaround required.

runners.comment: 2-4 on Flat; lacked fluency switched to hurdles last Sunday but may do better
runners.name: Chico Magnifica
runners.spotlight: Record of 2-4 on Flat for Karl Burke; lacked fluency and always behind at Huntingdon switched to hurdles last Sunday (caught the attention of the stewards) but may improve with that experience under his belt.

runners.comment: Consistent overall record; close second last time; possibilities on these terms
runners.name: Talakan
runners.spotlight: Has maintained the consistency he showed on the Flat in France by being placed in two juvenile hurdles, close second at Ludlow (2m, soft) latest; gets a sizeable 4yo allowance against his elders and has possibilities.

14:40.race_name: Oddschecker Free Bets Novices' Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Series Qualifier) (GBB) (Div II)

runners.comment: Steadily progressive; scored in big field at Lingfield most recently; respected
runners.name: Wondering Why
runners.spotlight: Drew 5l clear of his closest pursuer in big-field maiden at Lingfield (2m, soft) last time, adding to his good-ground bumper success and taking hurdles record to 321; steadily progressive and warrants respect.

runners.comment: Off the mark at the third attempt in Irish points; bred for further under rules
runners.name: Cosmic Connection
runners.spotlight: Raced three times in 3m Irish points, taking a big step forward with success the final occasion; not sure to have the pace for 2m, with pedigree suggesting he'll need further under rules.

runners.comment: Holds a major chance on penultimate effort, namely clear second at Sandown
runners.name: Ionian
runners.spotlight: Represents the Constitution Hill connections; record is 0-4 but he holds a major chance on penultimate effort, namely clear second at Sandown (2m); folded tamely over 2m4f latest; hood worn last twice is removed.

runners.comment: Has weak claims on his two hurdles efforts for new yard
runners.name: Lemon Leaf
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who has weak claims on his two hurdles efforts for new yard (modest third then duck egg); may be more interesting in handicaps shortly.

runners.breeder: S C E A Bertwood Stables Et Al
runners.comment: Has made the frame in both starts, latest on British debut; still open to progress
runners.name: Leo Wood
runners.spotlight: Has shown clear promise by making the frame at Compiegne (sole French start) and Ludlow (2m, soft); this half-brother to a Grade 1 scorer remains open to progress and is an interesting contender.

runners.comment: British debutant who holds poor claims on his French form
runners.name: Lumiere DEspoir
runners.spotlight: British debutant who holds poor claims on his French form; best watched unless the market suggests improvement is likely.

runners.comment: Four-time AW winner on Flat for Richard Hughes; fairly useful hurdles prospect
runners.name: Road To Wembley
runners.spotlight: Four-time AW winner at up to 2m on Flat for Richard Hughes, reaching an RPR of 85 (has shown a similar level of form on turf); remains with same owner; has the potential to become a fairly useful hurdler.

runners.comment: Has shown steady progress in juvenile hurdles, making all at Ludlow most recently
runners.name: King Al
runners.spotlight: Acts on any ground; dual Flat winner who has shown steady progress in juvenile hurdles, most recently making all at Ludlow (2m) where held on by a neck from Talakan (declared 2:10); one of the main players.

runners.name: Snow Is In The Sky
runners.spotlight: Beaten long way switched to rules last Monday and the form of her Irish point success remains open to question as the race fell apart.

runners.comment: Newcomer; half-brother to his connections' 2m6f chase winner Delgany Deadline
runners.name: Delgany Headline
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to his connections' 2m6f chase winner Delgany Deadline; dam French 1m2f Flat and 2m hurdle scorer, half-sister to two winners over jumps; sole newcomer in the field; check the betting.

runners.comment: Pulled up in both attempts over hurdles; hood applied
runners.name: Babychino
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in seller in sole Flat start; pulled up in both attempts over hurdles; first-time hood needs to make a big difference.

runners.comment: Open to progress in this second handicap attempt; market support would heighten interest
runners.name: Jimmy Hurdstrom
runners.spotlight: Point winner who has largely encouraging rules form and may be capable of progress in this second handicap attempt; returns from a break; market support would heighten interest.

runners.comment: Only 1-14 under rules (2-3 in points) but may still have more to offer for current yard
runners.name: Mount Anglesby
runners.spotlight: Ran creditably on bare figures last time when bidding for an Ascot double; only 1-14 under rules compared to 2-3 in points but may still have more to offer for current yard.

runners.comment: 2-2 switched to handicaps this term, namely autumn wins, latest over C&D; respected
runners.name: Got A Dream
runners.spotlight: Two from two switched to handicaps this term, namely good-ground wins in the autumn, latest over C&D with likely more in hand than the half-length margin suggests; respected with further improvement plausible.

runners.comment: Prevailed narrowly at Hereford last time; remains open to further progress over hurdles
runners.name: Kel Du Large
runners.spotlight: Prevailed narrowly in a duel with the runner-up, pair clear, at Hereford (2m3f, heavy) last time; Listed bumper winner in unbeaten 2023-24 campaign and remains open to further progress over hurdles; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Veteran who is far more exposed than most of these rivals
runners.name: Thankyourluckystar
runners.spotlight: Returned to form with creditable second at Southwell (2m4f) last time but looks unlikely to go one better; the 10yo faces a difficult task against several younger rivals who are open to further improvement.

runners.comment: Gained his Ludlow double on good ground; form has dipped on softer going since
runners.name: Ocean Conquest
runners.spotlight: Completed a good-ground double at Ludlow (2m/2m5f) in the autumn and softer going has perhaps contributed to his dip in form since; may resume his progress, provided the surface is ideal.

runners.comment: Back on last winning mark; fighting chance, provided he's back in top form
runners.name: Il Va De Soi
runners.spotlight: Comes with risk, having failed to complete in three of his last four starts (fences/hurdles); otherwise attractively weighted, having slipped back to last winning mark; fighting chance, provided he's in top form.

runners.comment: Ran well last time to sustain a solid record since handicapping; may do better still
runners.name: Ilitch
runners.spotlight: Eventually overhauled in a sustained duel with the winner at Doncaster (3m) most recently but ran well to sustain his solid record since handicapping; may do better still; possibilities back down in distance.

runners.comment: With his mileage so low, plenty of improvement may materialise now handicapping
runners.name: Jukebox King
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner who has finished fourth in both rules attempts, latest at Market Rasen (2m4f); with his mileage so low, plenty of improvement may materialise now handicapping; interesting contender.

runners.comment: Similar type to Thankyourluckystar; others preferred
runners.name: Gold Link
runners.spotlight: Similar type to Thankyourluckystar, being a 10yo who finished second at Southwell (2m4f) last time but seems unlikely to go one better in this field, against opponents who are mostly less exposed.

15:40.race_name: Get The Best Odds With Oddschecker Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Still lightly raced but didn't achieve a great deal when second of three last month
runners.name: Epinephrine
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on chasing debut in January and probably didn't achieve a great deal when second of three behind short-odds winner at Huntingdon (2m, heavy) last month; remains lightly raced but needs improvement here.

runners.comment: Ultimately well beaten in her first two chases but ran well for a long way last time
runners.name: Politacus
runners.spotlight: Ultimately well beaten in her first two chases but she ran well for a long way in higher-grade company at Ludlow (2m4f, soft; jumped left throughout) last month and this switch to a left-handed track is an obvious move.

runners.comment: Well beaten twice since winning chase debut but had possible ground excuse last time
runners.name: She Is For Me Boys
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who scored on seasonal/chase/handicap debut at Kempton (2m4f, good) in November; well beaten twice since but may not have been suited by soft ground last time; drops back in trip here and may still have potential.

runners.comment: Beat two rivals at Leicester in December and subsequent Taunton second was also a good run
runners.name: Irish Chorus
runners.spotlight: Won three-runner chase at Leicester in December, her second start over fences, and her subsequent second at Taunton (also 2m, good) was perfectly respectable; may not be ideally suited by the forecast slower ground here but still features prominently in calculations.

runners.comment: This season's largely consistent record includes a good second over C&D; respected
runners.name: Bobbis Beauty
runners.spotlight: Won two 2m chases last season (soft/good) and this season's largely consistent record includes a good second over C&D; current mark is workable; likely to be in the shake-up.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras De Magouet
runners.comment: Just a respectable third of four on chasing debut; absent since lesser effort in September
runners.name: Claim Du Brizais
runners.owner: Noel Fehily Racing Syndicate - Claim Du
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced and with a good stable but was just a respectable third of four on last summer's chasing debut at Fontwell (2m2f, good to soft) and we haven't seen her since a lesser effort in September.

16:13.race_name: Oddschecker Cheltenham Free Bets Handicap Hurdle (Challenger Stayers Hurdle Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Seemed to do just enough when prevailing narrowly at Haydock; player off 5lb higher
runners.name: Super Survivor
runners.spotlight: A thorough stayer who has won over fences; back in good form over hurdles following a break and seemed to do just enough when prevailing narrowly at Haydock (3m, good to soft); every chance off this 5lb higher mark.

runners.comment: No doubting his ability to be very competitive off this mark if he's back on song
runners.name: Bill Joyce
runners.spotlight: Bled from the nose when pulled up on chase debut in December; smart novice hurdler around 2m4f last season and no doubting his ability to be very competitive off this mark if he's back on song.

runners.comment: On a good mark but there's much to prove on first sighting since October
runners.name: Mars Harper
runners.spotlight: Best known as a chaser these days and was tailed off back over hurdles on his final run for Gordon Elliott, whom he left for £30,000; on a good mark but there's much to prove on first sighting since October.

runners.comment: The season started well but he's been back in the doldrums in his last two races
runners.name: Kyntara
runners.spotlight: Big improver during the 2023-24 season but chasing didn't go well last campaign; this one started well back over hurdles but he's been back in the doldrums in his last two races.

runners.comment: Placed in her final two races and those efforts were right up there with her best form
runners.name: Porter In The Park
runners.spotlight: Last two runs have seen her placed in handicaps at about 3m at Ascot and Kempton, both times under Cameron Johnstone-Baker; those efforts were right up there with her best form.

runners.comment: Point/bumper winner making handicap debut; market could be informative
runners.name: Big Cadillac
runners.spotlight: Point/bumper winner; disappointing favourite in a Southwell maiden last time (2m4f, soft; first-time tongue-tie) but thought good enough to contest a Grade 2 the time before and this initial mark may underestimate him; interesting to see which way he goes in the betting.

runners.comment: Third of 18 tried in cheekpieces at Ascot three weeks ago and should give his running
runners.name: Oh My Johnny
runners.owner: Richard Johnson Racing- Oh My Johnny
runners.spotlight: Last win was off this mark; no closer than about 9l this season but was third of 18 tried in cheekpieces at Ascot three weeks ago (extended 2m7f, good to soft) and he should give his running.

16:48.race_name: Best Cheltenham Odds With Oddschecker Volcano Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Has shown clear signs that he's capable of winning a chase; one to consider
runners.name: El Granjero
runners.spotlight: Ran poorly dropped back to 2m4f at Sandown last time but consistent otherwise and has shown clear signs that he's capable of winning a chase; possibly open to improvement at this new trip and one to consider.

runners.comment: Plumpton win last time took his chase record to 3-7; may show further progress
runners.name: Jubilant
runners.spotlight: Scored by 5l at Plumpton (3m1f, good to soft) when last seen, taking chase record to 3-7; on a career-high mark but may be capable of further progress and looks likely to have the stamina for this new trip.

runners.breeder: S C E A De Maulde Et Al
runners.comment: Successful in last two chase attempts but they were two years ago
runners.name: Loup De Maulde
runners.spotlight: Successful in last two chase attempts (2m7f) but they were two years ago and he needs to prove the form can still be repeated; market may offer further guidance in this second run back from long layoff.

runners.comment: Won the Southern National last term; possibilities off an attractive mark
runners.name: Unanswered Prayers
runners.spotlight: Landed the Southern National at Fontwell (3m3f, good) last term; form this season features two respectable efforts at Cheltenham, including in 3m5f cross-country race; possibilities off an attractive mark.

runners.comment: Record is only 1-17 but he is largely consistent (in the frame most starts)
runners.name: Muskoka
runners.spotlight: Record is only 1-17, the success over 3m1f, but he is largely consistent having made the frame in most starts; chance of doubling his tally partly depends on whether the new trip sparks a new level of form.

runners.breeder: Mme M Hanquiez Mr G Hanquiez & Earl L
runners.comment: December form suggests he's an ideal type for this assignment
runners.name: Jupiter Des Bordes
runners.spotlight: Below par the last twice but his December form, namely a game success at Warwick (3m) and close second over 3m4f at Haydock, suggests he's an ideal type for this assignment; interesting back here.

runners.comment: Off the mark in Doncaster event last time and looks open to further progress
runners.name: Mumfords Magic
runners.spotlight: Suited by the step back up to 3m at Doncaster (3m) last month on fourth chase attempt, building on reappearance effort and opening his account; may show additional progress upped further in distance; shortlisted.

runners.comment: Record of 211 since switched to chasing; form of course win last time has substance
runners.name: House Of Habsburg
runners.spotlight: Record of 211 since switched to chasing and the form of his Warwick success (3m1f, good to soft) last time has been boosted by the second/third since; respected off bottom weight upped in grade, with additional improvement plausible upped further in trip.

17:23.race_name: Black Pug Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Well-related gelding and Harry Cobden takes the reins; has to be of interest
runners.name: Chinese Whispers
runners.owner: S Foran G Macintosh & E Fenton
runners.spotlight: 35,000euros 3yo; seventh foal; half-brother to winners Range (useful 2m3f/2m4f hurdle/chase) and Whatsinaname (point); dam bumper and 2m-2m4f hurdle/chase winner; could easily run well with Harry Cobden taking the reins.

runners.breeder: Haras De La Haie Neuve & S Bouvier
runners.comment: 15-2 for a soft-ground bumper at Doncaster but was in trouble a long way out
runners.name: Country Pursuits
runners.spotlight: With Brian Hughes booked he went off only 15-2 for a soft-ground bumper at Doncaster but was in trouble a long way out and finished last; this surface may be more preferable.

runners.comment: A tailed-off last here in December when sent off at 200-1
runners.name: Earl Chester
runners.owner: D S Frankland & D J Trott
runners.spotlight: A tailed-off last here in December when sent off at 200-1.

runners.comment: Beat one other finisher in his point but has joined a top stable for £65,000
runners.name: Jetaway Holiday
runners.spotlight: Stable won this in 2019 with the high-class Chantry House; this gelding was bought for £65,000 after beating one other finisher in a fast-ground 2m4f maiden point at Eyton last May; tongue-tie fitted; commands respect.

runners.comment: Recruited for £72,000 after finishing third in an Irish point in November
runners.name: Merry Away
runners.spotlight: Recruited for £72,000 after finishing third in an Irish point in November (3m, yielding); that form has yet to be put under the miscroscope but he should have a future given the yard he's joined.

runners.comment: Beaten fav at Chepstow but finished his race out nicely and the form has worked out
runners.name: Presley
runners.spotlight: 185,000euros 3yo and well related; failed favourite backers at Chepstow in December (good to soft; 5-4) but he finished his race out nicely for third and the form has worked out well; every chance.

runners.comment: 75,000euros 3yo; has to be of interest representing the Murphy/Bowen combination
runners.name: Pride Hill
runners.spotlight: 75,000euros 3yo; second foal; dam well held in AW bumper only start, half-sister to useful 2m3f-3m1f hurdle/chase winner Tarablaze; has to be of interest representing the Murphy/Bowen combination.

runners.comment: Half-brother to stable star Edwardstone who was runner-up in this very bumper in 2019
runners.name: Wyrley Birch
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to stable star Edwardstone who was runner-up in this very bumper in 2019; stable also won this in 2022; interesting.

runners.comment: A disappointing favourite at Huntingdon but should be wiser for that experience
runners.name: Mister Coko
runners.spotlight: On the face of it he was disappointing at Huntingdon (good to soft) having gone off the 2-1 favourite but should be wiser for that experience.

runners.comment: 33-1 and trailed home last on soft to heavy ground at Naas a month ago
runners.name: Shaheeq
runners.spotlight: 33-1 and trailed home last on soft to heavy ground at Naas a month ago; cheekpieces replace a tongue-tie; should encounter very different conditions here.

14:20.race_name: CopyBet Supporting UK Horse Racing EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Scored on stable debut and ran well in defeat on next outing; has big role to play
runners.name: Lucy The Wire
runners.spotlight: Joined James Owen after promising debut in Ireland in October and won fillies' race at Leicester (1m7f, soft) on stable debut the following month; ran well in defeat against males at Wetherby (1m7f, good) in December and has another big role to play here; tongue-tie added.

runners.comment: Created pretty good impression when winning Newcastle bumper in November
runners.name: Majordomo
runners.spotlight: Out of a French hurdle/chase winner; created pretty good impression when winning eight-runner Newcastle bumper (good to soft) in November and must be considered on this hurdling debut.

runners.comment: Displayed clear promise on first two starts but needs to take a good step forward
runners.name: Masterfield
runners.spotlight: Displayed significant promise on both starts, more recently when fifth over C&D (good to soft) last month, but needs to take a good step forward to land this prize.

runners.comment: Ran well in Listed bumper in January and placed behind two useful rivals on hurdle debut
runners.name: Mollys Lad
runners.spotlight: Stayed on for very respectable fifth of 16 in Listed Cheltenham bumper (good ground) on New Year's Day and was placed behind two useful rivals on last month's hurdling debut at Doncaster (2m, good to soft); good chance.

14:50.race_name: First Past The Post At CopyBet Veterans' Handicap Chase (Qualifier) (Leg 3 Of The Stayers' Series)

runners.comment: Creditable second over 2m4f at Musselburgh last time but has stamina to prove today
runners.name: Tommys Oscar
runners.spotlight: Smart at around 2m in his prime and was creditable second off today's mark in valuable Musselburgh handicap (2m4f, good to soft) five weeks ago but has stamina to prove on first venture beyond about 2m4f under rules.

runners.comment: Ran quite well in January, after a layoff, but tailed off since; not easy to predict here
runners.name: Empire Steel
runners.spotlight: Very well handicapped on old form and returned from layoff with quite encouraging run at Musselburgh (2m7f, good to soft) in January but ought to have been suited by the heavy ground when tailed off at Kelso last month and it's hard to know what to expect from him here.

runners.comment: Well beaten in major handicap last month but now 3lb lower than when winning this in 2025
runners.name: Credo
runners.spotlight: Behind stablemate Blackjack Magic when seventh in final of this veterans' series at Sandown in January and was soundly beaten in major Ascot handicap last month but her first two runs this season were very respectable and she's now 3lb lower than when winning this race in 2025.

runners.comment: Ran quite well two starts ago but has become far too inconsistent to rely upon
runners.name: Blackjack Magic
runners.spotlight: Ran quite well when fifth in valuable final of this veterans' series at Sandown (3m, good) in January but was well beaten there later that month and has become far too inconsistent to support with any confidence; tried in a visor for the first time.

runners.comment: Ran big race in defeat in first-time visor in January; big player if in similar mood here
runners.name: Hillcrest
runners.spotlight: The huge promise he showed as a novice hurdler is a fading memory but he responded well to first-time visor when runner-up under positive ride at Uttoxeter (3m2f, soft) six weeks ago and has obvious claims if in the right mood again here.

15:20.race_name: Safer Gambling At CopyBet Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Overcame inexperience to score on Catterick hurdles debut; big shout with more to come
runners.name: Itsinthename
runners.spotlight: Made a promising start when runner-up in a Lingfield bumper (for Nigel and Willy Twiston-Davies) in January and built on it on his yard/hurdling debut when going one better in 2m Catterick maiden 12 days ago; still looked inexperienced there and he's a leading contender.

runners.comment: Won at Kelso; failed to kick on when a well-held third there since; worth another chance
runners.name: They Want Me
runners.spotlight: Point scorer who posted a fairly useful effort when getting off the mark in this sphere at Kelso (2m) in December; failed to kick on when a well-held third of 11 in 2m novice there last month but he's worth another chance for yard with an excellent record in this.

runners.comment: Offered little in a pair of bumpers and 2m novice hurdles; significantly more is required
runners.name: Big Jon
runners.spotlight: Offered little in a pair of bumpers and it's been a similar story in 2m novice hurdles at Newcastle and Kelso this year; significantly more is required from this son of Elusive Pimpernel.

runners.comment: Free when pulled up on hurdling debut in novice here 20 days ago; needs to settle better
runners.name: Forever Louie
runners.spotlight: Shaped well when runner-up in a Musselburgh bumper in December but went too freely when pulled up on his hurdling debut in 2m3f novice here 20 days ago; needs to become more tractable.

runners.comment: Promising start over hurdles after 19 months off when third at Musselburgh; likely player
runners.name: Guet Apens
runners.spotlight: A useful 1m4f French Flat winner in 2024 for Andre Fabre; 22-1, made a promising start over hurdles after 19 months off when third of 11 in 2m Musselburgh novice three weeks ago; should strip sharper now and a likely player.

runners.comment: Offered little in a pair of 2m novice hurdles for his current yard; has plenty to prove
runners.name: Jungle Jet
runners.spotlight: Placed in an Irish point but he's offered little in a pair of 2m novice hurdles for his current yard, undergoing breathing surgery before being pulled up at Wetherby on his return in January; has plenty to prove.

runners.comment: Yet to offer much in four runs over hurdles; it's easy to look elsewhere
runners.name: King Kodiak
runners.spotlight: Yet to offer much in four runs over hurdles, tried in cheekpieces when last of 11 in 2m Kelso novice 23 days ago; it's easy to look elsewhere.

runners.comment: A fair 1m4f Flat scorer for David Menuisier but yet to fire for his current yard
runners.name: Promethean
runners.spotlight: A fair 1m4f Flat scorer for David Menuisier but yet to fire for his current yard, including on his hurdling debut at Southwell (2m) last month; not easy to make a case for.

runners.comment: Remote sixth over C&D novice 20 days ago; more is needed from this son of Workforce
runners.name: The Foreman
runners.spotlight: Well held in a Haydock bumper back in 2022 and was having his first run since when a remote sixth of ten in a C&D novice 20 days ago; in good hands but significantly more is needed from this son of Workforce.

runners.comment: Well held in maiden hurdles at Wetherby/Bangor; others are much preferred
runners.name: Shouldvebeenshav
runners.spotlight: Third in a point and hinted at promise when sixth in a bumper here in November but hooded and well held in maiden hurdles at Wetherby and Bangor since; others are much preferred.

runners.comment: Little show over hurdles for her new yard; she's hard to warm to
runners.name: Blondina
runners.spotlight: Modest maiden in Ireland for Jim Bolger; has shown very little over hurdles for her new yard in Musselburgh juvenile and C&D novice this year; hard to warm to.

15:50.race_name: Best Odds Guaranteed Overnight At CopyBet Novices' Handicap Chase (Go North Forgive 'N Forget) (GBB)

runners.comment: Won three-runner race in December and has performed well twice since; in the mix again
runners.name: Benmore
runners.spotlight: Won three-runner chase at Leicester (2m, good) in December and probably bettered that form when second at Market Rasen (2m1f, good to soft) on Boxing Day; set to finish second again before last-fence fall at Southwell (2m, good to soft) last month and could plausibly have untapped potential over this longer trip.

runners.comment: Seemed to be getting act together over fences two starts ago but below that form since
runners.name: Kahavari
runners.spotlight: Yet to add to his French hurdle win in 2024; seemed to be getting his act together over fences when second at Huntingdon (2m, soft; first-time tongue-tie) in January but last month's well-held fifth at Ayr (2m, soft) was a backward step; moves back up in trip today.

runners.comment: Thriving mare who bids for a hat-trick after two clear wins this year, the latter over C&D
runners.name: Celestial Fashion
runners.spotlight: Thriving mare who bids to compete a hat-trick after clear wins at Wetherby (2m3f, soft) and over C&D (good to soft) this year; shooting up the weights but needs to be taken very seriously in current form.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: 0-9 under rules but posted good effort when second at Doncaster last month; respected
runners.name: Kadjar Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: 0-9 under rules but has made promising start to chasing career this season and posted good effort when second at Doncaster (3m, soft) last month; can cope with this drop back in trip and probably won't be far away.

16:25.race_name: Johnny Burke's Cheltenham Blog At CopyBet Handicap Chase (Go North Red Rum Series Qual') (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: S C E A Ecurie La Grugerie Et Al
runners.comment: Good second of seven over C&D last time; very much one to consider off an unchanged mark
runners.name: Hudson De Grugy
runners.spotlight: Back in good form for his current yard, landing 3m handicap chase at Wetherby in December and posting a good second of seven over C&D last time; very much one to consider off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Opened his account over fences over C&D last April but has failed to fire this season
runners.name: Mt Fugi Park
runners.spotlight: Opened his account over fences over C&D last April but has failed to fire this season, a remote sixth in 3m3f Market Rasen handicap in December; needs this switch of headgear to spark a resurgence.

runners.comment: Back from ten months off with encouraging second here; leading claims over longer trip
runners.name: Lady In The Park
runners.spotlight: Signed off last spring with a breakthrough chasing victory at Perth (3m) and she resumed after a ten-month absence with an encouraging second of six over 2m5f here last month; this return to further promises to suit so she holds leading claims for her resurgent yard.

runners.comment: Better signs with fourth at Chepstow 23 days ago; not out of things if building on it
runners.name: Latenightrumble
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark over fences at Wetherby (3m) in December 2024; little encouragement this term until fourth of 11 in 3m Chepstow handicap 23 days ago; this lightly raced 9yo is not out of this if able to build on that recent effort.

runners.comment: Remains without a victory since 2021 and he's been pulled up on his last three runs
runners.name: Marown
runners.spotlight: Remains without a victory since 2021 and he's been pulled up on his last three runs, most recently in 2m7f Newcastle handicap in January; he's not easy to make a case for.

runners.comment: Scored at Market Rasen but big letdown at Leicester since; shouldn't be written off
runners.name: Grandads Cap
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 6yo scored easily on just his second run over fences at Market Rasen (3m) in February but he proved a big letdown under a 7lb penalty at Leicester (2m4f) 11 days later; possibly found that run coming too quickly so shouldn't be written off.

runners.comment: Veteran C&D winner who arrives in good nick; he can go well again off an unchanged mark
runners.name: Super Citizen
runners.spotlight: Veteran C&D winner who arrives in good nick, third of 14 over C&D last month; he can go well again off an unchanged mark.

17:00.race_name: CopyBet Daily Profit Boost Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Won this a year ago; well below par this term but still not dismissed from a reduced mark
runners.name: Lady Babs
runners.spotlight: A three-time C&D scorer, including in this race 12 months ago; well below par this term, coming in last of 14 over C&D 20 days ago but this veteran mare still can't be totally dismissed from a plummeting mark.

runners.comment: Both her victories have come over C&D but she has been largely well below par this term
runners.name: Disco Annie
runners.spotlight: Both her victories have come over C&D but she has been largely well below par this term, mainly over fences; cheekpieces are reached for now and she has something to prove back hurdling.

runners.comment: Impressively off mark at Newcastle; big shout despite the drop back in trip and 6lb rise
runners.name: Holly Bird
runners.spotlight: Yard firmly back among the winners of late and she opened her account in some style in 2m4f handicap hurdle at Newcastle 15 days ago; always travelling strongly there so big shout despite the drop back in trip and 6lb weights rise.

runners.comment: Deserved breakthrough hurdling success at Catterick latest; not out of things up 2lb
runners.name: Vanilla Dancer
runners.spotlight: Reliable sort who gained a deserved breakthrough hurdling success in 2m Catterick handicap 27 days ago; not out of things nudged up 2lb.

runners.comment: Yet to fire in four runs over hurdles; could still do better dropped back in trip here
runners.name: Moonlightinthepark
runners.spotlight: Second in an Irish point but she's yet to fire in four runs over hurdles, tongue tied for her handicap debut when ninth of 12 at Ludlow (2m5f) last month; she's in good hands though and could still do better dropped back in trip here.

runners.comment: Well-held fourth at Musselburgh latest; needs this switch to h'caps to spark improvement
runners.name: Georgies Malt
runners.spotlight: Fair form shown when fourth in a pair of bumpers but she's failed to build on it sent hurdling, coming in a well-held fourth of six in 2m4f Musselburgh maiden three weeks ago; she needs this switch to handicaps to spark improvement.

runners.comment: Poor ex-Irish maiden; goes h'capping for good yard here so she's no forlorn hope
runners.name: Stage Lady
runners.spotlight: Only poor form shown over hurdles in Ireland for Norman Lee and also pulled up in a couple of points either side of Christmas; starts out handicapping for a good yard here though so she's no forlorn hope, especially if the market vibes are positive.

runners.comment: Below her Flat form but could improve given this stiffer test of stamina over hurdles
runners.name: Queen Roslyn
runners.spotlight: A fair 2m winner on the Flat in 2025; not at that level in four runs in this sphere, including on her handicap debut when a never-dangerous sixth of 13 at Catterick (2m) in January; she could still do better though after a break granted this stiffer test of stamina.

runners.comment: Remote fifth at Sedgefield in November; plenty more is needed after a four-month layoff
runners.name: Out On Her Own
runners.spotlight: Points scorer who also shaped well when a debut fourth in an Aintree bumper last May; hasn't translated that form to this sphere however, a remote fifth in 2m5f Sedgefield handicap in November; plenty more is needed after a four-month layoff.

17:35.race_name: Cheltenham Tuesday Bog Available At CopyBet Open Hunters' Chase

runners.comment: Won Ffos Las handicap last spring; hard to beat if fully tuned up for stable debut
runners.name: A Moments Madness
runners.spotlight: Low-mileage 7yo who opened account for Warren Greatrex with front-running success in Ffos Las handicap (2m3f, soft) last April; changed hands for £82,000 the following month and now makes his stable/hunter chase debut; could be hard to beat if fully tuned up.

runners.breeder: G A E C Devauzelle De Vauzelle
runners.comment: Pulled up good-quality Irish hunter chases on last two starts; makes stable debut today
runners.name: Galon De Vauzelle
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish 10yo who was quite useful in his prime; won a soft-ground point in the autumn but pulled up in two good-quality hunter chases since; this race is easier but he probably still needs to have been perked up by recent stable switch.

runners.comment: 0-8 under rules but won open point by 12l on last month's reappearance outing
runners.name: Bellaney Lord
runners.spotlight: 0-8 under rules but comes here after winning open point at Friars Haugh (2m4f, good to soft) by 12l on last month's reappearance outing and is evidently in very good nick; no surprise if he features.

runners.comment: Dual point winner last March but has more on his plate on this rules debut
runners.name: Greater Glory
runners.spotlight: In good form when last seen last March, winning two 3m points (maiden/restricted); has a bit more on his plate on this rules debut, though, and his fitness must be taken on trust.

runners.comment: Ran big race behind once-smart rival at Fakenham last month; respected
runners.name: Hollywood Harmon
runners.spotlight: Won by wide-margin at Cartmel (2m5f, good to soft) last spring and ran big race when second to once-smart rival at Fakenham (3m, soft) last month; it's quite tricky to weigh up what that recent piece of form is worth but, nevertheless, she's respected here.

runners.comment: Didn't fulfill potential for Dan Skelton; well beaten on recent stable/hunter chase debut
runners.name: Settle Down Jill
runners.spotlight: Won mares' novice hurdle (2m3f, good) for Dan Skelton in October but didn't really fulfill her potential for that stable and struggled to get competitive (albeit in stronger race than this) on stable/hunter chase debut at Haydock three weeks ago.
